reading: Each entry records what was read for the glow screen and what it was used for. Repository products and code were read in full where they feed the screen; outside sources were read as abstracts, publisher pages or search summaries, as each entry says, and only for the named measured values. Nothing here is admitted as a manuscript source, and no outside bytes are kept.
